story.iWant: an agent that buys the discounted stablecoin because it expects redemption at par
story.soThat: the replay can reproduce the observed trough and the note can say what decided March 2023
story.tasks: - Config and factory (AC: 2) - Agent (AC: 1, 3) - Fit (AC: 4, 5, 6) - Propagate (AC: 7) - ADR, tests, close out (AC: 8, 9)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–9. The redeem condition and fit rule in Dev Notes are normative.

docs.doc: Who the agent is, redeem condition, expected fit, what to watch in propagation.
Agent base contract, phase usage, decision-record shape, closed-form sizing (not needed here: the holder buys a fraction of balance, no targeting).

existing.reason: Closest existing agent: it also buys below band and redeems; copy its redeem-action construction and settle handling.
Holder reads these for its redeem condition.
Template for fit_holder.py; same selection rule.

story-context.constraints: - Schema change limited to HolderConfig + union membership; existing hashes unchanged (test). - No kernel/ or protocol/ changes. PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1. - The holder never sells on the AMM in this story. No panic rule. - Holder never calls ctx.rng. - C* chosen by the stated rule (two refinement passes, amended 2026-10-04); no hand-picking; D* is NOT re-fitted. - Propagated holder capital in the four other scenarios = C* × (their depth / D*), stated in each header. - VALIDATION.md keeps the 2.5 table and adds the 2.6 one; do not overwrite history. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: Holder(agent_id, capital, entry_discount_pct, pace, redeem_when_capacity=True, redeem_horizon_steps=10); classmethod from_config(cfg: HolderConfig)
type: Literal["holder"]; id: str; capital: float gt 0; entry_discount_pct: float ge 0; pace: float gt 0 le 1; redeem_when_capacity: bool = True
args: --scenario (default scenarios/usdc-2023.yaml), --target-bps (default -1373), --entry-discount 2.0, --pace 0.05, --workers, --output, --dry-run. Prints the grid table then "C* = (trough ) ≈ $".

tests.standards: pytest; holder unit tests with real modules and manual phases per 1.7; hash-stability test over every scenario in scenarios/; fit_holder --dry-run only in CI; replay and propagation runs are reported, not tested, except a short usdc-2023 run with the holder (max_steps 500).

test.idea: spot 0.99, discount 2% → hold_wait; spot 0.97 → hold_buy with pace × reference
holding stable, queue non-empty → hold_wait; queue empty → hold_redeem for min(stable, capacity × 10), one tranche per clear step
after redeem fulfilled at 0.999 on stable bought at 0.97: pnl > 0
all scenarios in scenarios/ hash identically before and after adding HolderConfig to the union (pin the hashes in a fixture)
trace on: one Decision per step with rule in the four names
